title: How `init` resets the ledger
description: Schema is applied only at the DATABASE step and no DDL runs afterward, so `init` cannot drop and recreate tables.

options.label: Delete all rows atomically through repository operations

title: When the non-negative balance rule is evaluated for a batch
description: The sources say no command may leave a balance below zero but do not say whether intermediate file order matters.

options.label: Check each account's final balance after the whole batch plus stored rows
Check the running balance in file order

title: Exit code for a load file whose header does not match
description: Exit codes list 1 for unreadable files and 3 for invalid file rows; a wrong header is not stated.

title: Precedence between not-found and invalid amount
description: `txn amend` and `txn delete` with an absent id and an invalid argument could exit 3 or 4.

options.label: Exit 4 for an absent id before validating other arguments

title: Transfer when category TRANSFER is not stored
description: Transactions reference categories, so the TRANSFER category must exist for a transfer to be stored.

options.label: Exit 3 as an unknown category and write nothing

title: Atomic multi-row writes
description: Loads, transfers, and init write several rows; atomicity is delivered by validating everything first and then writing inside the shipped persistence library's transaction facility, never by a raw driver.
system_choice: Validate fully before the first write, then perform all writes in one persistence-library transaction so a failure leaves no partial rows.
